description: In front of you on the bed are a stack of large blue cloths with pink edges on the left and a neat stack of small yellow cloths on the right. The right hand reaches to the blue stack, pinches and lifts a small blue cloth from the top, carries it to the right, lays it flat on the bed near the yellow stack, then lifts and adjusts one corner as if unfolding or aligning it; the right-hand object is the small blue cloth while the other stacks remain untouched.
